 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Recolor the full-width/full-height divider lines to color 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # In these puzzles, the divider color is the non-background color that
    # forms complete rows or columns; isolated marks of that color are kept.
    line_color = None
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if any(all(v == color for v in row) for row in grid) or any(
            all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)
        ):
            line_color = color
            break
    if line_color is None:
        return out
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == line_color for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h))]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
